confirm.scanIntro: This scan checks for changes in the library folders:
confirm.scanNew: Find new video files, identify them and add them to the library
confirm.scanMissing: Mark files that are no longer on disk. Records are kept and restored automatically if the files return.
confirm.scanMetadata: Fetch descriptions, posters and other details for newly added titles
confirm.scanProbe: The first scan reads video and audio details for every file. Large libraries take longer; you can stop at any time.
confirm.scanSafeCloud: Your files will not be moved, changed or deleted, including files on cloud drives.
confirm.scanSafe: Your files will not be moved, changed or deleted.
confirm.refreshLibraryIntro: For every title in this library, this refresh will:
confirm.refreshDetails: Fetch the latest descriptions, ratings, cast, crew and episode details
confirm.refreshArtwork: Download updated posters and backdrops, keeping any images you have locked
confirm.syncSidecars: Update posters and NFO files in the media folders
confirm.refreshTime: Large libraries take time. You can stop at any time.
confirm.videoSafe: Your video files will not be moved, changed or deleted.
confirm.refreshItemDetails: Fetch this title’s latest description, rating, cast and crew
confirm.refreshItemArtwork: Download posters and backdrops again, keeping any images you have locked
confirm.itemSafe: Your video files will not be changed.
confirm.readLibraryIntro: For every video in this library, this will:
confirm.readNfo: Read the matching NFO beside each video. Its title, description and collection details take precedence.
confirm.readSafe: No network requests. Your files will not be changed or deleted.
confirm.readItemSafe: No network requests. Your files will not be changed.
confirm.chaptersIntro: Runs in the background at low priority. Track or cancel it in the task center:
confirm.chaptersMissing: Only generate missing chapter images, including incomplete runs and lost images. Complete sets are kept.
confirm.chaptersReads: Each file is read at several chapter positions. Network-mounted libraries will use network traffic.
confirm.chaptersForceHint: Regenerate all images using the current chapter and compositing settings. Manually selected images are kept.
confirm.cloudListing: List the library folders on {cloud} again to find additions, moves and deletions
confirm.readLibraryTitle: Read NFO files and covers again for "{name}"?
confirm.readItemTitle: Read NFO and cover again for "{title}"?
confirm.nfoCollections: Use collection information ({tag}) in NFO files to group titles according to the library settings
